goal: Mining pilot slice 6 v4 (adds two finish-line items found by Codex discovery round 1: every record and every staff member is reachable by paging, and no change or removal silently overwrites someone else's change): staff training register per organisation at /dashboard/training (course, provider, completion date, optional expiry, evidence link, optional user-entered CARSI completion URL or certificate id). Owners and managers read and edit every record in their organisation; a technician reads only their own and cannot write; role and organisation re-read from the database; no CARSI API call; works with zero CARSI records; additive migration file with down.sql, never applied to any shared database

criteria.text: Access helper and paging/version helper unit tests pass: role and organisation come from the database; ADMIN and MANAGER read every record in their organisation and may write; USER (technician) reads only records where staffUserId is self within their current organisation and may not write; a user with no organisation or no user row reads nothing and may not write

Route guard tests pass: GET passes the organisation (and for a technician the self) filter to Prisma and pages with a cursor that is ANDed with that scope, so record 101 and beyond is reachable; a malformed cursor is 400; the staff list pages within the caller's organisation and is 403 for a technician; POST/PATCH/DELETE by a technician is 403 with no write; POST for a staff member outside the caller's organisation is 404 with no write; PATCH/DELETE of another organisation's record is 404 and the where carries organizationId; PATCH/DELETE carry the version the caller read, a missing version is 400 and a moved version is 409 with nothing written; the database expiry check on a race is 409 not 500; body carrying organizationId or staffUserId on PATCH is 400; unsigned-in is 401; bad links are 400; an empty register returns 200 with no records

Register panel tests pass: a manager sees the add form and every record; a technician sees no add, edit or delete control; the empty state renders with zero records; a CARSI reference is labelled as entered by the business and not checked with CARSI; 'Show more records' and 'Show more staff' fetch the next page; an edit sends only the changed fields plus the version it was made against, and a conflict shows the message and reloads; a removal carries the version

The migration is additive, cascades from organisation and staff member, enables row-level security, and its down.sql drops exactly what it adds (static layer of scripts/ci/__tests__/staff-training-register-rollback.test.ts, run with no DATABASE_URL). The Postgres apply, drift and rollback layer runs only in GitHub CI on a throwaway database: the local Bash migration roundtrip is refused by the Supabase write gate and is not routed around
criteria.recipe: env -u DATABASE_URL -u DIRECT_URL PATH=$HOME/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:/usr/local/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH node_modules/.bin/vitest run --config config/vitest.config.js scripts/ci/__tests__/staff-training-register-rollback.test.ts

criteria.text: No new code calls out to CARSI or fetches a user-entered link: no fetch, axios or http request in the new training library or routes
